text:
Type: flatwoven runner rug
Use: covering walkways and work spots; hallway, kitchen, entryway
Style: minimalist, contemporary, modern
Materials: tight synthetic-look flat weave, fine basket-weave texture
Colors: dark charcoal grey, black flecks
Shape: long narrow rectangle, small checked weave texture, thin flat profile, plain straight edges, solid and low-key
Feel: practical, understated, grounded, sturdy
Goes with: light or dark floors, white walls, black or steel accents; modern, industrial or minimalist hallways and kitchens

product.name: MORUM
product.description: The rug is perfect for outdoor use since it is made to withstand rain, sun, snow and dirt.
